description: T-275: 137 MHz polar-orbiter weather satellite imagery (SIGNAL-027 Meteor-M LRPT 137.1/137.9 MHz, SIGNAL-029 NOAA POES APT 137 MHz), native to the HackRF with a simple QFH/V-dipole (docs/use-cases.yaml hardware_fit: native) - no dish, no accessory. SatDump (GPLv3) exec'd as a subprocess behind hk-plugin-satdump (T-275), which owns the whole QPSK/FM demod, frame sync, Reed-Solomon and image chain: this is a reused decoder, not a reimplementation. The `pipeline` param selects SatDump's own pipeline id and is manifest-editable without rebuilding the wrapper (CLAUDE.md's no-rebuild-to-retune requirement); default targets Meteor-M2 LRPT. See docs/stream-contract.md §9, ADR-0010, ADR-0003.
